slides.title: WhatsApp Business ki *5 settings*. 10 minute, Sunday ko.
slides.sub: Har local business ke liye. Free app mein hi hain.

slides.title: 1. *Greeting message*
slides.sub: Naya customer pehli baar message kare to turant reply jaaye.
slides.box: "Namaste 🙏 [business] mein swagat. Kya chahiye: 1 Price  2 Timing  3 Booking"

slides.title: 2. *Away message*
slides.sub: Band hone ke baad aaye message ka jawab, taaki customer competitor ke paas na jaaye.
slides.box: "Abhi hum band hain. Kal 10 am pe sabse pehle aapko reply karenge."

slides.title: 3. *Quick replies*
slides.sub: Roz ke 5 sawaal (price, location, timing) ke jawab "/" se 1 second mein.

slides.title: 4. *Labels* + 5. *Catalog*
slides.sub: Labels: New lead, Paid, Follow-up. Catalog: top 10 products/services with price.
slides.box: Shaam ko sirf "Follow-up" label wale chats kholo.

slides.title: Ye 5 set hain? Ab *automation* ki baari.
slides.sub: Comment AUDIT, hum aapka WhatsApp setup free check karenge.

caption:
Sunday ko 10 minute: WhatsApp Business ki 5 free settings jo leads bachati hain. 📱

1️⃣ Greeting message: naye customer ko turant reply
2️⃣ Away message: band hone ke baad bhi jawab
3️⃣ Quick replies: /price, /location jaise shortcuts
4️⃣ Labels: New lead, Paid, Follow-up
5️⃣ Catalog: top 10 products with price

Sab free app mein: Settings → Business tools.

Save karo 🔖 aur aaj hi lagao.

📲 Ye setup aapke business mein bhi chahiye? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.

🏢 Parachar: local businesses ke liye websites, WhatsApp automation aur lead follow-up systems. Leads aayein, chhootein nahi.
